scope: Isolated pre-G0 device feasibility evidence; not production-app acceptance.
knownNotCovered: S1 Profile A/B comparison on the Infinix X6870
S2 Profile A/B performance comparison; Profile B is not implemented
S4/S5 host-side SSE and endpoint contract checks
S6 OpenCode 2.x contract test; no distributable 2.x artifact is available
S7 one 10-minute active-agent background-survival acceptance; this APK measures only a harness-service soak
TERM-5 real Gboard input acceptance; this APK only runs a scripted PTY byte round-trip
RT/STR/WS/TERM production-app and UI acceptance tests
SEC production security, second-UID, and release-manifest acceptance tests
S9 release, licensing, and distribution compliance
16 KB-page-device boot (out of scope for v1) and optional post-G0 memory/thermal checks

S1-A.title: S1 Profile A
S1-A.requirement: Loader, authenticated health, and mock-provider prompt on the reference device.

S1-B.title: S1 Profile B
S1-B.requirement: Profile B must run the same reference-device flow or be resolved by the S1 decision rule.

S2-cold.title: S2 cold start
S2-cold.requirement: Compare Profile A and B cold-start measurements.

S2-rss.title: S2 idle RSS
S2-rss.requirement: Compare Profile A and B idle memory measurements.

S2-git.title: S2 git status
S2-git.requirement: Compare git status on a 10k-file repository.

S2-npm.title: S2 npm test
S2-npm.requirement: Compare npm test through the agent for both profiles.

S3.title: S3 agent shell
S3.requirement: Compare actual agent bash with the guest shell and PTY environment.

S4.title: S4 SSE semantics
S4.requirement: Document resync behavior and pass STR-5 fault-injection checks.

S5.title: S5 endpoint inventory
S5.requirement: Reconcile pinned API docs, PTY routes, port, auth, and socket behavior.

S6.title: S6 OpenCode 2.x
S6.requirement: Check a distributable 2.x artifact when available; otherwise retain the documented 1.x pin.

S7-LC2.title: S7 / LC-2 active task
S7-LC2.requirement: One real agent task survives 10 minutes with the screen off on the reference device.

S8-TERM5.title: S8 / TERM-5 Gboard
S8-TERM5.requirement: Verify Gboard, paste/select, extra keys, resize, signals, and cleanup in the native terminal UI.
S8-TERM5.detail: Owner-accepted 2026-10-27: early Gboard field-input observations are green and the native-PTY byte round-trip passed; remaining native-terminal UI checks are recorded follow-ups.

S9.title: S9 release compliance
S9.requirement: Complete licensing, source-offer, signing, and distribution compliance evidence.

BASELINES.title: Baselines and thresholds
BASELINES.requirement: Record reference-device baselines and ratify numeric thresholds.

D1.title: D1 distribution decision
D1.requirement: Freeze the distribution decision from the required compliance evidence.

D4.title: D4 runtime profile
D4.requirement: Freeze the runtime profile using admissible S1/S2/S3 evidence.

D5.title: D5 version pin
D5.requirement: Confirm the exact OpenCode baseline and documented 2.x disposition.
